usedFor: Ideanote collects customer ideas, and MSG91 gets a ticket through “Send Mail via Hello” when “New Ideas” arrives.

bestTemplate.name: “New Ideas” in Ideanote, then “Send Mail via Hello” in MSG91
bestTemplate.why: Each new idea becomes an MSG91 ticket, so someone on your team owns the follow-up.

watchOut: “New Ideas” is polling, so tickets open after a scheduled check rather than the moment someone posts.
